notes.title: The copyright of
notes.content:
Dear,

Recently, there have been cases of infringement of our copyright by uploading main plot and endings of <Cheongchunhyang Jeon> on YouTube and other broadcasting platforms.

<Cheongchunhyang Jeon> is an FMV game, and it also has the characteristics of a 'drama' in which the story development is very important.

Therefore, please be aware that uploading the full version of the gameplay video or revealing the endings is an act of infringing the copyright of <Cheongchunhyang Jeon>, and may cause serious spoilers to other users as well.

Therefore, please note that we are requesting Youtube and other video platforms to remove copyright infringement videos such as exposing the ending of <Cheongchunhyang Jeon> or releasing the entire play video that reveals the story.

It is allowed to upload short parts of the video that are not spoilers.

We thank the majority of users for paying attention to copyright protection, and I hope you enjoy <Cheongchunhyang Jeon>.

Thank you.
